gen-righteous-gf-krona-one: Chunky and cheerful, Righteous bends its letters like thin steel rod. Krona One, a sans-serif, spreads out loosely below with lowercase as hefty as cast iron capitals, so paragraphs feel broad and sturdy.
gen-righteous-gf-magra: Righteous draws every letter with the steadiness of a technical pen, its bowls filling the line. Magra then takes over with a big-bodied sans feel in each lowercase word, doing the quiet work the heading would only shout through.
gen-righteous-gf-major-mono-display: Major Mono Display reads like neon glass, its monospace letters ringed with space and curves that sweep open. Righteous is the one to make a loud entrance, while this body font simply hums along precisely.
gen-righteous-gf-martian-mono: Martian Mono sets fixed-width, code-style letters well apart from each other. Righteous is built to command attention with bowls that fill the line, whereas the monospace body keeps everything structured and generously open.
gen-righteous-gf-matemasie: Righteous bends thin steel rod into bowls that fill the whole line, loud and good-humored. Matemasie does the opposite job, giving a sans body broad gaps between glyphs.
gen-righteous-gf-mitr: Mitr reads compact and friendly, with almost no gap between x-height and cap height. Righteous grabs attention with its rod-like strokes, while the sans body just gets on with the talking.
gen-righteous-gf-momo-trust-display: Momo Trust Display, a sans-serif, lets its generous x-height drift across the line with distant, spaced-out letters. Righteous holds its vertical and horizontal strokes at identical weight above.
gen-righteous-gf-mukta: Righteous has no calligraphic thinning anywhere, just bent rod and bowls that fill the line. Its strongest quality is that bold uniformity, set against Mukta, a clean sans-serif with tall-bodied small letters.
gen-righteous-gf-mukta-mahee: Righteous brings one stroke thickness everywhere, like steel rod bent into bold shapes, and the effect is loud fun. Its strongest quality is the contrast with Mukta Mahee, a sans with chunky, tall lowercase.
gen-righteous-gf-mukta-malar: Approachable describes Mukta Malar, a sans whose compressed ascender length keeps lines tight, while Righteous holds its line thickness firm above it. And a modest heading size would let the body text stay comfortable beneath it.
